title: ClientOptimizationSuite
script:
--!strict

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

export type TroveTask = RBXScriptConnection | Instance | () -> () | thread

export type EngineConfig = {
    TargetFramerate: number,
    SamplingWindow: number,
    AdaptiveThrottling: boolean,
    AggressiveLOD: boolean,
}

local DEFAULT_CONFIG: EngineConfig = {
    TargetFramerate = 60,
    SamplingWindow = 0.5,
    AdaptiveThrottling = true,
    AggressiveLOD = true,
}

local Trove = {}
Trove.__index = Trove

function Trove.new()
    return setmetatable({ _tasks = {} :: { TroveTask } }, Trove)
end

function Trove:Add<T>(task: T & TroveTask): T
    table.insert(self._tasks, task)
    return task
end

function Trove:Clean()
    for _, task in ipairs(self._tasks) do
        if typeof(task) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
            task:Disconnect()
        elseif typeof(task) == "Instance" then
            task:Destroy()
        elseif typeof(task) == "function" then
            task()
        elseif typeof(task) == "thread" then
            task.cancel(task)
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._tasks)
end

local ObjectPool = {}
ObjectPool.__index = ObjectPool

function ObjectPool.new(template: Instance, prewarmSize: number)
    local self = setmetatable({}, ObjectPool)
    self._template = template
    self._pool = {} :: { Instance }
    self._container = Instance.new("Folder")
    self._container.Name = "_Pool_" .. template.Name
    self._container.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

    for _ = 1, prewarmSize do
        local obj = template:Clone()
        obj.Parent = self._container
        table.insert(self._pool, obj)
    end
    return self
end

function ObjectPool:Acquire(): Instance
    local obj: Instance
    if #self._pool > 0 then
        obj = table.remove(self._pool) :: Instance
    else
        obj = self._template:Clone()
    end
    return obj
end

function ObjectPool:Release(obj: Instance)
    obj.Parent = self._container
    table.insert(self._pool, obj)
end

function ObjectPool:Destroy()
    self._container:Destroy()
    table.clear(self._pool)
end

local OptimizationEngine = {}
OptimizationEngine.__index = OptimizationEngine

function OptimizationEngine.new(config: EngineConfig?)
    local self = setmetatable({}, OptimizationEngine)
    self.Config = config or DEFAULT_CONFIG
    self.Trove = Trove.new()
    
    self.RemoteRegistry = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "v" }) :: { [Instance]: number }
    self.PartCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: { [BasePart]: boolean }
    
    self.CurrentFramerate = 60
    self.IsThrottled = false
    self.IsActive = false

    return self
end

function OptimizationEngine:ApplyEngineOverrides()
    pcall(function()
        local settingsObj = settings()
        local physics = settingsObj:GetService("Physics")
        if physics and Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle then
            physics.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle = Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle.DefaultAuto
        end
        
        local network = settingsObj:GetService("Network")
        if network then
            network.IncomingReplicationLag = 0
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if Enum.InterpolationThrottlingMode then
            Workspace.InterpolationThrottling = Enum.InterpolationThrottlingMode.Enabled
        end
        if Enum.AnimatorRetargetingMode then
            Workspace.Retargeting = Enum.AnimatorRetargetingMode.Disabled
        end
    end)
end

function OptimizationEngine:InitRemoteObserver()
    local roots = { ReplicatedStorage, Workspace }
    
    local function register(instance: Instance)
        if instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") or instance:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
            self.RemoteRegistry[instance] = os.clock()
        elseif self.Config.AggressiveLOD and instance:IsA("BasePart") then
            self.PartCache[instance] = true
        end
    end

    task.defer(function()
        local yieldThreshold = 250
        local count = 0
        for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
            for _, child in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                register(child)
                count += 1
                if count % yieldThreshold == 0 then
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
        self.Trove:Add(root.DescendantAdded:Connect(register))
        self.Trove:Add(root.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(child)
            if self.RemoteRegistry[child] then
                self.RemoteRegistry[child] = nil
            end
            if self.PartCache[child :: BasePart] then
                self.PartCache[child :: BasePart] = nil
            end
        end))
    end
end

function OptimizationEngine:InitAdaptiveMonitor()
    local lastCheck = os.clock()
    local frameCount = 0
    local targetFrametime = 1 / self.Config.TargetFramerate

    self.Trove:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
        frameCount += 1
        local now = os.clock()
        
        if now - lastCheck >= self.Config.SamplingWindow then
            self.CurrentFramerate = frameCount / (now - lastCheck)
            frameCount = 0
            lastCheck = now

            if self.Config.AdaptiveThrottling then
                self:AdjustFidelity(dt > (targetFrametime * 1.25))
            end
        end
    end))
end

function OptimizationEngine:AdjustFidelity(shouldThrottle: boolean)
    if shouldThrottle == self.IsThrottled then return end
    self.IsThrottled = shouldThrottle

    if shouldThrottle then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        for part, _ in pairs(self.PartCache) do
            if part.Parent and part.CastShadow then
                part.CastShadow = false
            end
        end
    else
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
    end
end

function OptimizationEngine:GetMemoryReport(): { TotalMB: number, LuauHeapKB: number, ActiveRemotes: number }
    return {
        TotalMB = Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb(),
        LuauHeapKB = gcinfo(),
        ActiveRemotes = self:GetTrackedRemoteCount(),
    }
end

function OptimizationEngine:GetTrackedRemoteCount(): number
    local count = 0
    for remote, _ in pairs(self.RemoteRegistry) do
        if remote.Parent ~= nil then
            count += 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

function OptimizationEngine:Start()
    if self.IsActive then return end
    self.IsActive = true

    self:ApplyEngineOverrides()
    self:InitRemoteObserver()
    self:InitAdaptiveMonitor()
end

function OptimizationEngine:Stop()
    self.IsActive = false
    self.Trove:Clean()
    table.clear(self.RemoteRegistry)
    table.clear(self.PartCache)
end

local System = OptimizationEngine.new({
    TargetFramerate = 60,
    SamplingWindow = 1.0,
    AdaptiveThrottling = true,
    AggressiveLOD = true,
})

System:Start()

return {
    System = System,
    ObjectPool = ObjectPool,
    Trove = Trove,
}
features:
High-performance client runtime optimizer.
    Implements frame-budget throttling, weak-table instance tracking,
    non-blocking StreamingEnabled observers, and deterministic memory teardown.
    
    API Surface:
    - OptimizationEngine.new(config: EngineConfig?) -> EngineInstance
    - EngineInstance:Start() -> ()
    - EngineInstance:Stop() -> ()
    - EngineInstance:GetMemoryReport() -> { TotalMB, LuauHeapKB, ActiveRemotes }
    - ObjectPool.new(template: Instance, prewarmSize: number) -> PoolInstance
